title: Expose a supported count of pending runtime observation reports by wire format, without store access or bodies
outcome: An operator or agent can learn, through a supported host surface, how many runtime observation reports are still unsettled or have settled as local failures, split by wire format (legacy content-v1 or source_id). It needs no live-store access, and the surface never exposes request bodies, source_ids or payloads.
acceptance: A supported read-only host surface returns total reports, unsettled and local failure counts plus envelope counts by content-v1, source_id, source-free and unknown, and by delivery state; mixed or malformed rows are classified explicitly, with no bodies, ids, free text or calls to Engram or the store.
Behaviour tests use mixed states and wires plus reload and prove the output contains only counters and fixed labels, with delivery and state unchanged.
Ordinary exact focused checks, a review pair and the final gate apply.

completion.summary: Delivered numeric-only runtime observation custody counts via supported GET, with actual reload/privacy/real-builder coverage; landed in Combo25.
